headline: Union Quality Plastics Board Meeting Agenda
summary: Union Quality Plastics Ltd to hold board meeting on September 8, 2026. Agenda includes AGM notice, MD appointment of Javeri Kapisha Udaya Kumar Singh, and resignation of Jeethendra Singh Goud.

headline: Pankaj Polymers sets Sep 30 date for 34th AGM
summary: Pankaj Polymers Limited has scheduled its 34th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The meeting will be held via video conferencing. Remote e-voting begins on September 27.

headline: Asian Energy Services holding gets Arunachal mining LOI
summary: Asian Energy Services Ltd disclosed its holding company OEPL received a Letter of Intent from the Government of Arunachal Pradesh for a vanadium and graphite block. The assets will vest in AESL post-merger.

headline: Advent Hotels AGM set for Sep 29, 2026
summary: Advent Hotels International Ltd has scheduled its 20th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The meeting will be held via video conferencing. The FY26 Annual Report is now available on the company website.

headline: Sheraton Properties AGM set for Sep 30, 2026
summary: Sheraton Properties & Finance Ltd schedules its 41st AGM for September 30, 2026. The agenda includes adopting FY26 accounts and approving related-party transactions.

headline: Coffers Finvest AGM set for Sep 30, 2026
summary: Coffers Finvest Limited schedules its 43rd AGM for September 30, 2026. The meeting will adopt FY26 financials and reappoint director Kshitij Agrawal via VC.

headline: Sanmit Infra AGM and E-Voting Schedule
summary: Sanmit Infra Ltd to hold 26th AGM on September 30, 2026 via video conference. Remote e-voting through CDSL opens September 27. Shareholders must hold shares as of September 23 cutoff.

headline: Awfis Space Solutions to host investor meeting on Sep 8
summary: Awfis Space Solutions Limited will hold an in-person group meeting with Ambit Capital in Mumbai on September 8, 2026. The company disclosed the schedule under SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Transchem AGM: Shareholders approve all resolutions
summary: Transchem Limited shareholders approved all three resolutions at the 49th AGM, including a related-party transaction with Crest Ventures. Promoters voted in favor of financials and board reappointment.

headline: Indrayani Biotech AGM extended to Nov 2026
summary: Indrayani Biotech Ltd secured a two-month extension for its FY26 AGM from ROC Chennai. The delay facilitates capital restructuring and rights issue planning.

headline: Prime Securities FY26: Revenue surges 54% on wealth push
summary: Prime Securities Ltd reported a 54.3% YoY rise in consolidated revenue to ₹1,276.8 crore for FY26. However, PAT fell 66% to ₹143.3 crore due to heavy investment in its new wealth management arm.

headline: Escorts Kubota schedules investor meetings
summary: Escorts Kubota has scheduled analyst and institutional investor meetings for September 11, 14, and 17, 2026. The company will engage with Enam Asset Management, Baillie Gifford, and East Bridge Capital.

headline: Super Fine Knitters AGM Book Closure Dates
summary: Super Fine Knitters Ltd sets book closure from September 24 to 30, 2026 for its 28th AGM. The meeting is scheduled for September 30, 2026.

headline: Nagarjuna Agri Tech AGM: Bakery Acquisitions
summary: Nagarjuna Agri Tech schedules 38th AGM for Sep 29, 2026. Shareholders to vote on ₹18.75 crore acquisitions of Kathleen Confectioners and Aarini Gourmet LLP.

headline: Panthaora Ltd AGM set for Sep 30, 2026; posts net loss
summary: Panthaora Limited (formerly JMG Corporation Limited) schedules its 37th AGM for September 30, 2026, reporting a net loss of ₹106.93 lakhs in FY26 against a profit of ₹8.45 lakhs in FY25.

headline: Concor wins Rs 89.09 crore order from Eastern Railway
summary: Concor secured a confirmed work order worth Rs 89.09 crore from Eastern Railway for BLSS wagons. The deal represents 3.8% of average quarterly revenue. No prior orders disclosed in last 3 quarters.

headline: Blueblood Ventures AGM set for Sep 30
summary: Blueblood Ventures Limited has scheduled its 19th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The agenda includes adopting FY26 financial statements and the re-appointment of Managing Director Suresh Bohra.

headline: Neuland Labs approves ₹126 crore land purchase
summary: Neuland Laboratories Ltd approved ₹126 crore capital expenditure to buy 134 acres in Kakinada for future expansion, funded via internal accruals.

headline: Tata Technologies hosts investor day on Nov 19
summary: Tata Technologies Limited announced its first-ever Investor Day scheduled for November 19, 2026, in Mumbai. Interested parties must register by October 30, 2026.

headline: Anjani Foods AGM: FY26 results, goodwill write-off
summary: Anjani Foods Limited will hold its 42nd AGM on September 29, 2026. The company reported a 3.93% revenue rise to ₹5,529.53 lakh in FY26, though net profit fell 67% due to a ₹115.69 lakh goodwill impairment.

headline: Parnax Lab AGM: RPTs, Auditor Appointment
summary: Parnax Lab schedules 44th AGM for September 29, 2026. Key agenda items include approving related-party transactions with subsidiary Naxpar Pharma and appointing Ladha Singhal & Associates as statutory auditors.

headline: Artemis Ebix sets AGM date, approves annual reports
summary: Artemis Ebix board approved FY26 annual reports and fixed September 30 for its 60th AGM. The company will hold remote e-voting from September 27 to 29, 2026.

headline: Texel Industries AGM: New Director Appointment
summary: Texel Industries schedules 37th AGM for September 29, 2026. Key agenda includes reappointment of Naresh Mehta and appointment of Rasesh Shah as Non-Executive Director.

headline: Rajasthan Securities to hold 33rd AGM on Sept 22
summary: Rajasthan Securities Limited has scheduled its 33rd AGM for September 22, 2026. The company is also sharing weblinks for the FY26 Annual Report with shareholders lacking registered email IDs.

headline: Kati Patang Lifestyle appoints new chairperson
summary: Kati Patang Lifestyle Limited appointed Sanjay Kumar Jain as chairperson for five years. Gokul Naresh Tandan resigns from the post but continues as managing director.

headline: BCL Industries to host analyst meet on Sep 11
summary: BCL Industries Limited has scheduled a virtual group meeting with analysts and institutional investors for September 11, 2026. The event is part of the GIA Alco Bev Day schedule.

headline: Tirupati Sarjan sets book closure for AGM
summary: Tirupati Sarjan Ltd will close its register of members from September 23 to 29, 2026, ahead of its 31st Annual General Meeting scheduled for September 30, 2026.

headline: Dish TV schedules 38th AGM for September 29
summary: Dish TV India Limited has scheduled its 38th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The meeting will be held via video conferencing, with e-voting open from September 26 to 28.

headline: Nirmitee Robotics promoter acquires 8.5 lakh shares
summary: Promoter Padma Kartik Shende acquired 8,49,990 equity shares via inter-se transfer on September 7, 2026. The transaction valued at ₹1.44 crore increases his holding to 23.60% of the company's paid-up capital.

headline: Apollo Techno FY26 Results: IPO boosts equity, profit dips
summary: Apollo Techno Industries reported a 53% drop in standalone net profit to ₹532.2 lakh for FY26, despite a 4.5% rise in revenue. The company completed its IPO, raising ₹479.6 crore and boosting equity significantly.

headline: Dachepalli Publishers AGM set for Sep 29
summary: Dachepalli Publishers Limited has scheduled its 28th Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The agenda includes adopting FY26 financials and reappointing two directors.

headline: Transworld Shipping acquires two container vessels
summary: Transworld Shipping Lines board approves acquisition of OEL Surya and OEL Varun from Orient Express Lines Inc. for a combined consideration of USD 42.78 million.

headline: CAMS to host analyst call on Sep 21, 2026
summary: Computer Age Management Services Ltd will hold a virtual meeting with Millennium Partners on September 21, 2026. The firm will use its August 3 investor presentation for the discussion.

headline: Ansal Housing sets Sept 29 AGM for FY26 results
summary: Ansal Housing Limited has scheduled its 42nd Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The meeting will be held via video conference to discuss the annual report for FY26 and transact other business.

headline: 63 Moons subsidiary issues ₹70 crore shares to FTSPL
summary: A subsidiary of 63 Moons Technologies issued shares worth ₹70 crore to FTSPL, raising FTSPL's stake in Ticker to 65.80%.

headline: Jackson Investments AGM scheduled for Sept 30, 2026
summary: Jackson Investments Limited has scheduled its 44th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The meeting will be held via video conferencing, with remote e-voting available from September 27 to 29.

headline: Unified Data-Tech Solutions to hold AGM on Sep 30
summary: Unified Data-Tech Solutions Limited will hold its 16th AGM on September 30, 2026. Remote e-voting opens on September 26 for shareholders on record as of September 23.

headline: Mindspace REIT to hold investor conferences in Mumbai, Gurgaon
summary: Mindspace Business Parks REIT management will participate in physical investor meetings in Mumbai on Sep 8 and Gurgaon on Sep 17. Presentations are available on the company website.

headline: Styrenix to host investor meet on Sep 10
summary: Styrenix Performance Materials Ltd will host a virtual analyst and institutional investor meeting on September 10, 2026. The session will cover publicly available information without discussing UPSI.

headline: Neo Infracon promoter acquires 3,000 shares
summary: Promoter Bhavik N. Mehta bought 3,000 shares of Neo Infracon Ltd in the open market on September 4, 2026. His stake rose to 6.55% from 6.49%, adding 3,000 equity shares to his holding.

headline: Shri Venkatesh Refineries approves annual report, AGM date
summary: The board of Shri Venkatesh Refineries Limited approved the annual report and fixed the date for its 24th AGM. The meeting also covered related party transactions and auditor appointments.

headline: Balu Forge Industries schedules investor meetings on Sep 10
summary: Balu Forge Industries Limited has announced a schedule of analyst and institutional investor meetings for September 10, 2026. The physical one-on-one sessions will be held with Tree Line Investment, Indus Nippon Life Insurance, Kotak MF, and Nuvama AMC.

headline: B&B Triplewall sets dividend record date
summary: B&B Triplewall Containers fixes September 18, 2026 as the record date for its final dividend for FY26. The payout is subject to shareholder approval at the upcoming AGM.

headline: Magnus Steel AGM: Revenue surges 608% to ₹2,258 lakh
summary: Magnus Steel & Infra posts a sharp profit turnaround in FY26, with revenue jumping 608% and net profit rising to ₹450.55 lakh. The 48th AGM on September 30, 2026, will address director appointments and a registered office shift.

headline: Sword-Edge appoints Ashish Anand as independent director
summary: Sword-Edge Commercials Ltd appointed Mr. Ashish Anand as an additional non-executive independent director for a five-year term. The board also designated CTO Mr. Tushar Parekh as senior management personnel.

headline: Prime Securities AGM on Sep 29, 2026
summary: Prime Securities Limited has scheduled its 43rd Annual General Meeting for September 29, 2026. The meeting will adopt FY26 financials and re-appoint director Sujit Kumar Varma via VC/OAVM.

headline: GEE Ltd AGM adjourned to Sept 12 due to quorum
summary: GEE Limited adjourned its Annual General Meeting held on September 7, 2026, due to a lack of quorum. The rescheduled meeting is set for September 12, 2026, at 11:30 am via video conferencing.

headline: Vipul Organics Q1FY27 Results: PAT nearly doubles
summary: Vipul Organics reported a 99.7% YoY rise in net profit to ₹2.53 crore for Q1FY27, driven by 37.7% revenue growth. The company also commenced operations at its new Sayakha greenfield facility.

headline: Fedders Holding AGM: Board reshuffle on agenda
summary: Fedders Holding Limited has scheduled its 35th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The agenda includes the reappointment of Vishal Singhal and the regularisation of three new directors.

headline: Fedders Holding FY26 results: Consolidated profit surges 142%
summary: Fedders Holding Limited reported a consolidated net profit of ₹913.1 crore for FY26, up 142% YoY, driven by exceptional items and subsidiary performance. Standalone operations posted a loss of ₹57.1 lakh.

headline: Prakash Industries sets AGM, dividend record date
summary: Prakash Industries schedules 45th AGM for September 30, 2026. Record date for ₹1.80 final dividend fixed at September 16. E-voting opens September 27.

headline: Motherson Sumi Wiring to host investor meeting on Sep 10
summary: Motherson Sumi Wiring India Ltd will hold a virtual one-on-one investor meeting with Enam Asset Management on September 10, 2026, at 11:30 am. The session is scheduled for one hour under SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Tera Software fixes record date for dividend and AGM
summary: Tera Software Limited has fixed September 22, 2026 as the record date for the dividend and e-voting eligibility for its 32nd AGM. The register of members will remain closed from September 23 to September 29, 2026.

headline: Tranway21 appoints new independent directors
summary: Tranway21 Technologies appoints two non-executive independent directors and approves AGM notice for FY26. The board also recommended re-appointments of key management personnel.

headline: JSW Dulux faces ₹48.59 Cr GST demand
summary: JSW Dulux Ltd received a show cause notice from Karnataka GST Department for input tax credit disallowance. The notice demands ₹48.59 crore for the period April 2022 to March 2023.

headline: Riddhi Steel & Tube sets AGM, book closure dates
summary: Riddhi Steel & Tube Ltd board approved the notice for its 25th AGM and fixed the book closure period. The company also appointed a scrutinizer for the upcoming annual meeting.

headline: Rajputana Stainless wins two power project contracts
summary: Rajputana Stainless has secured two power project contracts worth ₹227.1 million and ₹162.1 million, marking a significant order win for the company.

headline: Urban to meet analysts and investors on Sep 14 and 21
summary: Urban has scheduled meetings with analysts and investors on September 14 and September 21, signalling ongoing engagement with the investment community.

headline: Piramal Finance to meet analysts and investors on Sep 14
summary: Piramal Finance has scheduled a meeting with analysts and investors on September 14. The engagement is aimed at institutional and market participants.

headline: SBI warns of disruptions from bank union strikes
summary: State Bank of India has cautioned that its operations may be affected by bank union strikes scheduled on September 11, September 28-30, and an ongoing strike starting October 26.

headline: Eureka Forbes to host investors at UBS India Summit 2026
summary: Eureka Forbes Limited will meet institutional investors at the UBS India Summit 2026 on September 10, 2026, in Mumbai. The physical group meeting is part of regulatory disclosures under SEBI Listing Regulations.

headline: Rachit Prints Approves Board Report, AGM Details
summary: Rachit Prints Ltd board approved FY26 Board Report and Secretarial Audit. The 23rd AGM is scheduled for September 30, 2026, via video conferencing.

headline: Adani Power Q1FY27: Profit up 33% on strong margins
summary: Adani Power reported a 33% YoY rise in net profit to $514 million for Q1FY27, driven by 20% revenue growth and improved EBITDA margins. The company maintains a robust pipeline with 23.7 GW locked-in capacity.

headline: Yaan Enterprises AGM: ₹50 crore RPTs
summary: Yaan Enterprises schedules 37th AGM for September 30, 2026. Key agenda includes approving related-party transactions worth ₹50 crore and re-appointing Dr. Veena Ranjith.

headline: KEI Industries schedules investor meets on Sep 10-11
summary: KEI Industries will hold physical meetings with analysts and institutional investors in Mumbai on September 10 and 11, 2026, organized by Axis Capital and UBS Securities.

headline: Trident Texofab approves AGM, reappoints director
summary: Trident Texofab Limited board approves FY26 results and AGM notice. The meeting also sees the appointment of a new cost auditor for the upcoming fiscal year.

headline: BF Utilities appoints Ajay Kirtane as independent director
summary: BF Utilities has appointed Ajay Charuchandra Kirtane as an additional non-executive independent director for a five-year term. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.

headline: Adani Power Q1FY27: Profit jumps 47% YoY
summary: Adani Power reported a 47% YoY rise in net profit to ₹4,867 crore for Q1FY27, driven by a 33% revenue increase. The company maintains a robust pipeline of 23.7 GW in locked-in capacity.

headline: SVA India approves AGM notice, auditor appointments
summary: SVA India Ltd held its board meeting on September 7, 2026. The board approved the draft annual report for FY26 and scheduled the 45th AGM for September 30. It also appointed new statutory and secretarial auditors.

headline: Blueblood Ventures FY26 Results: Profit up 4.5x, Suspended
summary: Blueblood Ventures reported a 4.5x rise in net profit to ₹3.26 lakh for FY26 on higher revenue. The company's trading remains suspended since 2022 due to regulatory non-compliance.

headline: Ganesh Holdings turns profitable in FY26, eyes capital hike
summary: Ganesh Holdings Limited reported a net profit of ₹16.03 lakh for FY26, reversing a loss of ₹23.90 lakh in the previous year. The company also seeks approval to increase its authorized share capital to ₹1.5 crore.

headline: Abhishek Finlease sets AGM record date
summary: Abhishek Finlease Ltd will close its register of members from September 24 to 30, 2026 for its 31st Annual General Meeting. Shareholders must hold units on record date to participate.

headline: Concor wins ₹89.09 crore contract from Eastern Railway
summary: Container Corporation of India secures a ₹89.09 crore contract from Eastern Railway for 12 rakes of BLSS wagons, marking a significant logistics order win.

headline: Intrasoft Technologies AGM Book Closure Dates
summary: Intrasoft Technologies sets book closure for its 31st AGM from September 23 to 29, 2026. The cut-off date for remote e-voting eligibility is September 22, 2026.

headline: KIMS Ltd to host investor meet on Sep 10
summary: Krishna Institute of Medical Sciences Ltd will host an institutional investor meeting on September 10, 2026, at its Mahadevpura facility. The event is organized by Emkay Global.

headline: Agarwal Fortune FY26 Results: Profit drops 68% on higher costs
summary: Agarwal Fortune India reported a 68% drop in net profit to ₹6.22 lakh for FY26, despite revenue rising 27% to ₹562.43 lakh. The decline was driven by a surge in finance costs and inventory buildup.

headline: Satani Bearings FY26 Results: Profit turns positive
summary: Satani Bearings Ltd reported a net profit of ₹5.12 lakh for FY26, reversing the previous year's loss. The company generated revenue of ₹35.44 crore, driven by trading activities and related-party sales.

headline: Rollatainers files FY26 annual report
summary: Rollatainers Limited has submitted its 55th Annual Report for the financial year 2025-26 to BSE and NSE. The filing, dated September 7, 2026, is available electronically and on the company website.

headline: Shiprocket Q1 Results: Loss Narrows, Revenue Jumps
summary: Shiprocket reported a consolidated net loss of ₹137 million for Q1, down from ₹180 million YoY. Revenue surged 34% to ₹5.92 billion, signaling improved operational scale.

headline: ICICI Prudential Life: APE up 23.4% YoY in August
summary: ICICI Prudential Life Insurance reported August APE growth of 23.4% YoY, while August NB premium growth came in at 10.0% YoY.

headline: Bharat Serums gets nod for voluntary liquidation
summary: Mankind Pharma's subsidiary Bharat Serums and Vaccines has received approval for voluntary liquidation, subject to pending creditor consent.

headline: Swiggy plans to sell full stake in Lynkks Logistics
summary: Swiggy has announced plans to divest its entire stake in Lynkks Logistics Limited, marking a significant corporate restructuring move by the food delivery platform.

headline: GE Vernova T&D wins top bid for 6000 MW HVDC project
summary: GE Vernova T&D India has emerged as the top bidder for Power Grid's 6000 MW HVDC terminal station project connecting Barmer II to South Kalamb.

headline: Symphony plans entry into room AC, fans, air purifiers
summary: Symphony plans to gradually enter the room AC, BLDC ceiling fans, and air purifier segments by December 2026, adopting an asset-light model funded internally.

headline: Containe Technologies to hold 18th AGM on Sept 30
summary: Containe Technologies Limited approved the convening of its 18th Annual General Meeting for September 30, 2026. The board also cleared the FY26 Annual Report and appointed a scrutinizer for the voting process.

headline: Behari Lal Engineering Q1FY27 Results: Profit up 24% YoY
summary: Behari Lal Engineering Ltd reported a 24% YoY rise in Q1FY27 net profit to ₹191.94 million, driven by a 18% revenue increase to ₹1,516.74 million following its recent IPO listing.

headline: Lexoraa Industries approves AGM, director appointments
summary: Lexoraa Industries Ltd held its board meeting on September 7, 2026, to approve the 31st AGM notice and appoint key directors. The board also regularized two independent directors and appointed secretarial auditors for five years.

headline: Krishna Capital AGM on Sep 30, 2026
summary: Krishna Capital & Securities Ltd sets Sep 30, 2026 for its 32nd AGM. Book closure runs from Sep 23 to Sep 30. E-voting opens Sep 27.

headline: Spice Lounge FY26 Results: Profit up 36% YoY
summary: Spice Lounge Food Works reported a 36% YoY rise in standalone net profit to ₹26.4 lakh for FY26. Consolidated revenue surged 50% to ₹1,584.2 lakh driven by IT and food services.

headline: Quality Power to host investor plant visit on Sep 11
summary: Quality Power Electrical Equipments Ltd will host investors and analysts for a physical plant visit at Winwin Speciality Insulators Limited on September 11, 2026, as part of its proposed acquisition.

headline: HRS Aluglaze AGM: Key Resolutions and Financials
summary: HRS Aluglaze schedules 14th AGM for Sept 30, 2026. Key agenda items include auditor appointment, RPT approvals, and MD remuneration hike. FY26 PAT doubled to ₹1,021.62 lakh.

headline: SBL Infratech appoints internal auditor, sets AGM date
summary: SBL Infratech Ltd approved the appointment of M/s Appa & Associate as internal auditor for FY27 and scheduled its AGM for September 29, 2026.

headline: Campus Activewear to host investor meet at UBS India Summit
summary: Campus Activewear Ltd schedules an in-person investor interaction at the UBS India Summit on September 10, 2026, in Mumbai. The company confirms no UPSI will be discussed.

headline: Devinsu Trading open offer sees zero tendered shares
summary: Acquirers Jaison Shah, Mukesh Bothra, and Yora Gems received no share tenders in their open offer for Devinsu Trading. The group retains a 29.17% stake via SPA.

headline: Tirupati Sarjan FY26 Results: Net profit falls 8%
summary: Tirupati Sarjan Limited reported a net profit of ₹474.2 lakh for FY26, down 8% YoY, on revenue of ₹21,925.7 lakh. The company reduced gross debt by 15% and retained earnings for future projects.
